prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: single dropped-weapon pickup sprite for a 2D Sengoku beat-'em-up
Input images: Image 1 is only a style reference for the game's painted sprite rendering and magenta background; do not reproduce any soldier.
Composition/framing: one complete weapon resting diagonally on the ground, centered in a single square 256x256 game cell, occupying about 70% of the canvas, with at least 20px clear margin.
Style/medium: detailed painted anime-realistic 2D arcade sprite with crisp dark outlines, cel-shaded steel and wood highlights, consistent with Image 1.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat pure #FF00FF magenta, no ground plane or cast shadow.
Constraints: a single unheld, dropped weapon, fully visible and physically plausible; no hands or characters; no text, labels, frame, border, extra items or watermark.
Primary request: a distinct Japanese Sengoku yokai blade pickup: a realistic single-edged katana with a modest curve, dark steel blade, restrained deep crimson-purple hamon, black wrapped hilt and compact iron tsuba. Rest it diagonally with the hilt at lower-left and point at upper-right. The uncanny character comes from the blade's dark red-violet metal treatment, not magical effects.
Materials/textures: forged steel, subtle irregular temper line, aged black iron and dark red cord.
Avoid: flames, aura, floating particles, runes, text, huge fantasy blade, skulls, blood.
